name: 5th Grade Mathematics
description: Grade 5 mathematics, organized into the 13 units of the attached scope and sequence.

source.note: Unit titles, instructional order, and lesson topics follow the supplied document; standard codes are retained as printed.

standards.CC.2.1.5.B.1: Apply place-value concepts to show an understanding of operations and rounding as they pertain to whole numbers and decimals.
standards.M05.A-T.1.1.1: Demonstrate an understanding that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 1/10th of what it represents in the place to its left.
standards.M05.A-T.1.1.2: Explain patterns in the number of zeros of the product when multiplying a number by powers of 10 and patterns in the placement of the decimal point when a decimal is multiplied or divided by a power of 10. Use whole-number exponents to denote powers of 10.
standards.M05.A-T.1.1.3: Read and write decimals to thousandths using base-ten numerals, word form, and expanded form.
standards.M05.A-T.1.1.4: Compare two decimals to thousandths based on meanings of the digits in each place using >, =, and < symbols.
standards.CC.2.1.5.B.2: Extend an understanding of operations with whole numbers to perform operations including decimals.
standards.M05.A-T.2.1.1: Multiply multi-digit whole numbers (not to exceed 3 digit by 3 digit).
standards.M05.A-T.2.1.2: Find whole-number quotients of whole numbers with up to four-digit dividends and two-digit divisors.
standards.M05.A-T.1.1.5: Round decimals to any place (limit rounding to ones, tenths, hundredths, or thousandths place).
standards.M05.A-T.2.1.3: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals to hundredths (no divisors with decimals).
standards.CC.2.2.5.A.1: Interpret and evaluate numerical expressions using order of operations.
standards.M05.B-O.1.1.1: Use multiple grouping symbols (parentheses, brackets, or braces) in numerical expressions and evaluate expressions containing these symbols.
standards.M05.B-O.1.1.2: Write simple expressions that model calculations with numbers and interpret numerical expressions without evaluating them.
standards.M05.B-O.2.1.1: Generate two numerical patterns using two given rules.
standards.M05.B-O.2.1.2: Identify apparent relationships between corresponding terms of two patterns with the same starting numbers that follow different rules.
standards.C-G.1.1.1: Identify parts of the coordinate plane (x-axis, y-axis, and the origin) and the ordered pair (x-coordinate and y-coordinate). Limit the coordinate plane to quadrant I.
standards.C-G.1.1.2: Represent real-world and mathematical problems by plotting points in quadrant I of the coordinate plane and interpret coordinate values of points in the context of the situation.
standards.CC.2.1.5.C.2: Apply and extend previous understandings of multiplication and division to multiply and divide fractions.
standards.A-F.2.1.3: Demonstrate an understanding of multiplication as scaling (resizing).
standards.CC.2.1.5.C.1: Use the understanding of equivalency to add and subtract fractions.
standards.M05.A-F.1.1.1: Add and subtract fractions (including mixed numbers) with unlike denominators.
standards.M05.A-F.2.1.1: Solve word problems involving division of whole numbers leading to answers in the form of fractions (including mixed numbers).
standards.M05.A-F.2.1.2: Multiply a fraction (including mixed numbers) by a fraction.
standards.M05.A-F.2.1.3: Demonstrate an understanding of multiplication as scaling (resizing).
standards.M05.A-F.2.1.4: Divide unit fractions by whole numbers and whole numbers by unit fractions.
standards.CC.2.4.5.A.1: Solve problems using conversions within a given measurement system.
standards.M05.D-M.1.1.1: Convert between different-sized measurement units within a given measurement system (a table of equivalencies will be provided).
standards.CC.2.4.5.A.4: Solve problems involving computation of fractions using information provided in a line plot.
standards.M05.D-M.2.1.1: Solve problems involving computation of fractions by using information presented in line plots.
standards.CC.2.3.5.A.2: Classify two-dimensional figures into categories based on an understanding of their properties.
standards.M05.C-G.2.1.1: Classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on properties.
standards.CC.2.4.5.A.5: Apply concepts of volume to solve problems and to relate volume to multiplication and to addition.
standards.M05.D-M.3.1.1: Apply the formulas V = l × w × h and V = B × h for rectangular prisms to find volumes of right rectangular prisms with whole-number edge lengths in the context of real-world and mathematical problems. Formulas will be provided.
standards.M05.D-M.3.1.2: Find volumes of solid figures composed of two non-overlapping right rectangular prisms.
standards.CC.2.4.6.B.1: Demonstrate an understanding of statistical variability by displaying, analyzing, and summarizing distributions.

Convert Customary Units of Weight and Capacity

Convert Metric Units of Length, Mass, and Capacity
